key.key1: Move mouse left/right to steer, away from vehicle to speed up and closer to slow down - click to fire waterballoons.
key.key2: Or use left/right arrow keys to steer and back to brake - press space to fire waterballoons.

trackHint.title: COMPLETE LAPS
trackHint.hint: Finish 4 laps before the track floods to win & unlock the next level

balloonHint.title: WATER BALLOONS
balloonHint.hint: Pick up water balloons to throw at other racers

instructions.title: HOW TO PLAY
instructions.body_1: Drive Shaun around the track 4 times before the track floods
instructions.body_2: Steer using your arrow keys or mouse - back arrow to brake
instructions.body_3: Use water balloons & the hosepipe to dip other sheep
instructions.body_4: Get dipped after the flood warning and the race will end
